_doc: Summon errands (B outside a safe zone): the hero's summon or familiar carries a pack to the nearest market. It sells any non-quest item and buys only the items in `buy` at the safe-zone price (js/items/economy.js SHOPS.safezone markup). The pack has `slots` slots shared by sales and purchases; a purchase slot holds one item type, up to `stack` of it. The trip takes `baseSeconds` + `perSlotSeconds` per used slot, and the runner can't fight (or be summoned) until it is back.
